title: Bevany Resources Job Openings at Bevany Resources
content:
Bevany Resources is a recruitment and human talent support firm dedicated to connecting qualified candidates with forward-thinking employers. We specialise in talent acquisition, candidate screening, interview coordination, and providing recruitment support services to organisations across various industries. Our mission is to ensure businesses build strong teams while helping job seekers find meaningful career opportunities.

We are recruiting to fill the positions below:

1.) Business Development Manager

Job Location: Port Harcourt, Rivers
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Summary
     

        



     (adsbygoogle = window.adsbygoogle || []).push({});
    
    




	We are seeking a dynamic and results-oriented Business Development Manager to join our team. The Business Development Manager will play a crucial role in identifying new business opportunities, building and maintaining client relationships, and driving revenue growth.
	The successful candidate will have a strong understanding of our industry, excellent communication skills, and a proven track record in sales and business development.


Key Responsibilities


	Develop and maintain up-to-date and comprehensive knowledge about the business practices and industry trends.
	Head the team preparing bids, tenders, and other contract documents
	Ensure all statutory payments needed for bids are complete and up to date.
	Conduct market research to identify potential clients, industry trends, and competitive opportunities.
	Prepare and execute relevant presentations to new and existing clients to ensure seamless client onboarding and satisfaction.
	Maintain an all-inclusive client database system to serve as a guide for follow-up and other relationship management activities for existing and new clients.
	Coordinate with related functions within the company to ensure timeliness and accuracy in dealing with client (potential or existing) related transactions.
	Develop and recommend innovative strategies for client retention
	Ensure compilation and timely delivery of progress reports to the management team
	Participate in industry-related conferences and client forums as the company’s representative.
	Liaise between the company and key agencies in the industry
	Interfacing with industry regulators and follow up on submitted tenders
	Generate work orders, Request for Quotation (RFQ) and Purchase Orders (P0) and also leads through various channels such as Nipex, networking, referrals, and digital marketing.


Qualifications


	Bachelor's Degree in Business, Marketing, or a related field (Master's degree is a plus).
	An engineering background would be an added advantage
	Proven experience in sales, business development, or a related role.
	Strong understanding of the industry and market trends.
	Excellent communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills.
	Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
	Results-oriented with a track record of meeting or exceeding sales targets.
	Adapt to creating and delivering sales presentations.
	Ability to maintain confidentiality and handle sensitive information.


Benefits


	Competitive salary (N350,000 per month) and performance-based incentives.
	HMO
	Retirement savings plan.
	Opportunities for professional development and growth.
	Positive and collaborative work environment.


Application Closing Date: 24th November, 2026.

Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: [email protected] using "Business Development Manager PH" as the subject of the email.

 

2.)  Admin Officer

Job Location: Port Harcourt, Rivers
Employment Type: Full-time
Industry: Oil & Gas Engineering — Procurement Services
Reports to: Managing Director / Business Development Manager

Role Summary


	The Admin Officer will provide administrative and operational support to ensure smooth day-to-day running of the office, documentation, and coordination between departments.


Key Responsibilities


	Manage office administration, correspondence, filing, and documentation
	Support the BDM with preparation and organization of bid/tender documents and client files
	Maintain records of vendor registrations, certifications, and compliance documents
	Coordinate schedules, meetings, and follow-ups for management and business development
	Handle procurement of office supplies and vendor/contractor payment tracking
	Liaise with external parties (regulatory bodies, clients, suppliers) as needed
	Maintain company database/records (clients, staff, contracts)
	Provide general support across HR, finance, and operations as required.


Requirements


	HND / Bachelor's Degree in Business Administration or related field
	2 - 4 years of administrative experience in the oil & gas or engineering sector preferred
	Proficient in MS Office (Word, Excel, Outlook)
	Strong organizational and multitasking skills
	Good written and verbal communication
	High level of discretion and attention to detail.


Salary
N150,000 – N200,000 / month.

Application Closing Date: 18th November, 2026.

Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: [email protected] using Job Position as the subject of the email.

 

3.) Cashier

Job Location: Mushin, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time
Industry: Pharmacy
Work Schedule: Monday – Friday + Alternate Saturdays

Job Summary


	We are seeking a reliable, customer-focused, and detail-oriented Cashier to join our client’s pharmacy team in Mushin.
	The successful candidate will be responsible for processing customer transactions accurately, handling payments, maintaining proper cash records, and providing excellent customer service.


Key Responsibilities


	Receive and process customer payments accurately through cash, POS, transfers, and other approved payment methods.
	Issue receipts and ensure all transactions are properly recorded.
	Balance cash and POS transactions at the end of each workday.
	Maintain accurate records of daily sales and payments.
	Attend to customers courteously and professionally.
	Assist customers with basic enquiries and direct pharmacy-related questions to the appropriate staff.
	Verify prices and quantities before processing transactions.
	Report discrepancies, payment issues, or suspected fraudulent transactions to the supervisor.
	Maintain a clean and organized checkout area.
	Support stock checks and other basic administrative duties when required.
	Ensure all cash-handling procedures and company policies are followed.
	Perform other duties assigned by the supervisor or management.


Requirements


	Minimum of SSCE/OND; additional qualifications are an advantage.
	Previous experience as a cashier, sales attendant, POS operator, or in a similar customer-facing role is preferred.
	Basic computer literacy and ability to operate POS terminals.
	Good numerical and record-keeping skills.
	Excellent customer service and communication skills.
	High level of honesty, integrity, and attention to detail.
	Ability to work effectively in a busy pharmacy environment.
	Must be able to work Monday to Friday and alternate Saturdays.
	Candidates who live in or around Mushin and nearby areas are preferred.


Key Qualities:


	Honest and trustworthy
	Accurate and detail-oriented
	Customer-focused
	Punctual and responsible
	Good communication skills
	Neat and presentable
	Ability to work under pressure


Salary
N80,000 per month.

Application Closing Date: 25th October, 2026.

Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: [email protected] using Job Position as the subject of the email.

Industrial Electrical Technician Job at City print & Publishing




        
    

        
        City print & Publishing is a company specialized in custom printing, laminating, extrusion in both mono-layer and multilayer, slitting, cutting and pouch conversion of flexible packages for a wide variety of industries.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Industrial Electrical Technician

Job Location: Idu Industrial, Abuja (FCT)
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Summary


	We are seeking competent and experienced technical personnel to join our factory maintenance team in Idu Industrial Area, Abuja.


Key Responsibilities
     

        



     (adsbygoogle = window.adsbygoogle || []).push({});
    
    




	Maintain, troubleshoot and repair industrial electrical systems and production machinery.
	Diagnose electrical faults in extrusion, printing, lamination, cutting and injection machines.
	Work with three-phase motors, control panels, contactors, relays, sensors and electrical wiring.
	Handle electrical maintenance for water-production equipment.
	Carry out routine inspections and preventive maintenance to minimise machine downtime.
	Observe industrial electrical safety standards.


Requirements


	3-5 years of relevant industrial experience.
	Technical qualification in Electrical Engineering or a related field.
	Practical experience with factory machinery, motor controls and industrial electrical fault diagnosis.
	Experience in packaging, plastics manufacturing or water-production equipment is an advantage.
	Strong safety awareness and reliability.


Salary
N120,000 - N170,000 monthly, depending on experience.

Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the mail.

Note: Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted for interview and practical assessment.

  "title": "Mobile Developer (React Native + Expo)",
  "description": "Sage Grey Technologies is a Nigerian Company incorporated as a Venture Studio for technology startups and investments. A technology provider that creates impact by developing and deploying practical and sustainable solutions across various sectors.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Mobile Developer (React Native + Expo)
Job Location: Lagos (Remote)
Employment Type: Contract

About the Role


	We are looking for a skilled and passionate Mobile Developer with strong experience in React Native and Expo to join our engineering team.
	The ideal candidate will be responsible for building high-quality, scalable, and user-friendly mobile applications for both iOS and Android platforms.
	You will work closely with product managers, designers, and backend engineers to deliver reliable mobile experiences while ensuring performance, security, and maintainability.


Responsibilities


	Design, develop, and maintain cross-platform mobile applications using React Native and Expo.
	Build reusable, scalable, and efficient mobile components.
	Convert UI/UX designs into responsive and pixel-perfect mobile interfaces.
	Integrate RESTful APIs and third-party services.
	Implement authentication flows, push notifications, deep linking, and app navigation.
	Manage application state using modern state management solutions.
	Optimize mobile applications for performance, speed, and reliability.
	Debug and resolve application issues across Android and iOS devices.
	Handle mobile app builds and deployments using Expo Application Services (EAS).
	Publish and manage applications on Google Play Store and Apple App Store.
	Collaborate with backend developers to define and integrate APIs.
	Write clean, maintainable, and well-documented code.
	Participate in code reviews and follow mobile development best practices.


Requirements


	Strong experience building mobile applications with React Native.
	Hands-on experience with Expo framework and Expo Application Services (EAS).
	Strong knowledge of JavaScript and TypeScript.
	Experience with React Hooks and functional components.
	Understanding of mobile application architecture and lifecycle.
	Experience with navigation libraries such as React Navigation.
	Experience with state management tools (Redux, Zustand, Context API, or similar).
	Ability to integrate REST APIs and third-party SDKs.
	Experience handling local storage solutions such as AsyncStorage, SQLite, or SecureStore.
	Understanding of mobile authentication and security best practices.
	Experience debugging applications using React Native development tools.
	Familiarity with Git and collaborative development workflows.
	Good understanding of responsive design across different screen sizes.
	Must have completed NYSC.


Nice to Have:


	Experience working with native modules.
	Knowledge of Swift or Kotlin is a plus.
	Experience with Firebase services (Authentication, Cloud Messaging, Analytics, Crashlytics).
	Experience implementing maps, geolocation, payments, camera, and media features.
	Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines for mobile applications.
	Understanding of App Store and Play Store review processes.
	Experience with performance monitoring tools such as Sentry.


Technical Stack:
Mobile:


	React Native
	Expo
	TypeScript
	JavaScript


State Management:


	Redux / Zustand / Context API


APIs &amp; Services:


	REST APIs
	Firebase
	Push Notifications
	Third-party SDK integrations


Development Tools:


	Expo EAS Build
	Git
	App Store Connect
	Google Play Console


Soft Skills:


	Strong problem-solving skills.
	Ability to take ownership of mobile features.
	Attention to detail and user experience.
	Ability to work independently and collaborate with a team.
	Passion for building high-quality mobile products.


Method of Application&nbsp;
Interested and qualified candidates should send their Resume to: hr@sagegreytech.com using the Job Position as the subject of the mail.",
